verdict.rationale: Customer.io's core product is automations that are triggered by events or segment membership and then run on their own (docs-12, docs-30). The MCP server, CLI and in-app agent let an AI tool create and manage those automations (docs-1, docs-26, docs-27), and the agent itself can run recurring tasks on a schedule (docs-33). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that AI-created automations run reliably unattended, and deeper docs on the scheduled agent tasks beyond reports, audits and recaps.
